title: Impressed "well" for 3" pillar is off-centered.
text: Impressed "well" for 3" pillar is off-centered.. This is overpriced,considering that I think it is a "second".  The impressed well in the center in which you place a 3" candle is off-center. I had to fill in that part with self-stick little plastic feet / door bumpers in order to center my candle.  The next ring is for a 4" candle, and from that point on it is fine.  However, I believe this plate is made for a 3" candle, the most common size pillar candle.  Once you get your candle centered, the plate is pretty, but really just plain glass.
